      Fixes #12020
Description
When performing a search using a shape geometry query of relation type QueryRelation.CONTAINS, it is possible to get a false positive when two geometries intersect, but neither actually contains the other. This happens if the indexed geometry is a polygon that is so flat that one of its triangles is simplified to a single line segment. The bug is that the line segment currently records whether it is part of the external polygon by taking that knowledge from first line segment of the triangle, not necessarily the part of the triangle being retained. This first line segment could be an internal line (part of the triangle, but not the polygon). The simplification code should instead take this knowledge from a line segment that is not being collapsed by the simplification. The consequence of this bug occur later during the contains search when the search query deduces that the geometry is contained because the polygon is not closed. The search does not realise it intersects an outer line of the polygon because that line is not correctly marked as outer.
The fix is to select the correct flag from the surviving line segments instead of the first line segment.

Fixed. The bug was in `ShapeField.resolveTriangleType` (lucene/core/src/java/org/apache/lucene/document/ShapeField.java), which simplifies degenerate (flat) triangles into line segments during decode.

**Root cause:** When a triangle collapses to a `LINE`, the code reassigns the vertex coordinates so the surviving segment is stored as edge `ab`, but the `ab` "belongs to original shape" flag was left untouched — it still described the edge that was collapsed away (often an internal/diagonal edge). The CONTAINS query then used `withinLine(..., triangle.ab, ...)` with a wrong flag, treating an outer polygon line as internal and reporting a false positive.

**Fix** (matching the upstream resolution of this issue): in each of the three collapse branches, the surviving line's `ab` flag is now merged from the edges that are not being collapsed:
- `a==b` collapse → `triangle.ab = triangle.bc | triangle.ca` (surviving segment is a↔c)
- `a==c` collapse → `triangle.ab = triangle.ab | triangle.bc` (surviving segment is a↔b)
- `b==c` collapse → `triangle.ab = triangle.ab | triangle.ca` (surviving segment is a↔b)

**Validation** (in the container):
- `TestLatLonShape.testFlatPolygonDoesNotContainIntersectingLine` — the previously failing FAIL_TO_PASS case — now passes.
- All `org.apache.lucene.document.*` tests (314) and `org.apache.lucene.geo.*` tests (179) pass, so no regressions in the shape/geo query suites.

No test files were modified; the only change is the 3-line fix plus comments in `ShapeField.java`.
